headline: Anthem Biosciences Limited files SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure
sum: Anthem Biosciences Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) on substantial acquisition of shares, signalling a material change in shareholding structure that triggers mandatory public disclosure.
detail: Anthem Biosciences, a listed pharmaceutical company, has submitted a Regulation 31 disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) require disclosure by the acquirer within 2 working days of acquisition/crossing a slab of shares. The filing does not yet disclose the acquirer's identity, shareholding %, or offer price in the headline; these are detailed in the form DIS-4 appended to the NSE announcement.
